added_by.description: Filter by who added the source: human (you added it) or learned (from a resolved support ticket).

library_id.description: Return only sources in this library. Do not combine with unfiled.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the source name and URL.

source_type.description: Filter to a single source type (text, url, or file).

unfiled.description: When true, return only sources that are in no library. Do not combine with library_id.
